sanjay: RC created for promotion request: rw-api:rc-2026-03-17-c3
artifact: gcr.io/redwood/rw-api:rc-2026-03-17-c3 (build 0x7f9a4b)
cut from main @ commit f3e2a9
change window requested: 2026-03-18 03:00-06:00 UTC (rolling canary)
smoke: staging smoke passed; e2e: green; perf: see notes below. Requesting sign-off + pin to release config. /cc @ellie @mike @thuy

ellie: LGTM from my side. Staging smoke was clean. One thing to flag: quantization config for l4 models changed in this RC — I'll eyeball quality metrics before promote.

mike: Quick perf summary: median latency +2.1% at 512 tokens on g4dn; p95 roughly equal. Added perf ticket RD-321 for tracking. Recommend canary schedule: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks between steps.

qa-bot: E2E results: all suites PASS (run id 20260317-45). Flaky tests noted: chat-timeout-6 (ignored for this run). Artifacts stored at gs://redwood-ci/runs/20260317-45

thuy: Oncall ack — change window fine. Rollback plan: pin back to rc-2026-03-17-c2 (previous artifact) and scale down new replica set; no DB migrations in this RC. I will be oncall during promotion.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deployment -> start: 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z
plan: canary 5% (10m) -> 25% (20m) -> 50% (30m) -> 100% (15m)
regions: us-west2, us-east4
deploy-id: deploy-4421

sanjay: Pin request: please pin rw-api:rc-2026-03-17-c3 in the release registry and update release config. If no objections by 23:30 UTC today I'll mark approved and push for the promote job.

ellie: no objections from me. :thumbsup: Also please add a bullet in release-notes about the quantization tweak for the l4 family.

mike: Adding a safety rule: if error rate >1.5x baseline for 2 consecutive intervals during any step, abort rollout and rollback. I'll add the override to the rollout policy now.

sanjay: Approved. I'll run final promote checklist at 23:50 UTC and hand off to releases. Draft release notes: https://docs.internal/release-notes/rc-2026-03-17-c3

deploy-bot: promotion initiated (23:52:10 UTC). Artifact pinned: gcr.io/redwood/rw-api@sha256:abcd1234efgh. Canary started: 5% in us-west2/us-east4. Monitor channel: #prod-monitoring. If abort condition hits, automatic rollback to rc-2026-03-17-c2 will be enacted.
